qe: A combo offer says, "Buy 2 shirts at ₹1200 each, get a third shirt free." What is the effective price per shirt?
qh: एक कॉम्बो ऑफर कहता है, "₹1200 प्रत्येक पर 2 शर्ट खरीदें, तीसरी शर्ट मुफ्त पाएं।" प्रति शर्ट प्रभावी मूल्य क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Grahak kul 3 shirts prapt karta hai (2 kharidi + 1 muft).
Step 2: Grahak dwara bhugtan ki gayi kul rashi = 2 * ₹1200 = ₹2400.
Step 3: Kul rashi aur shirts ki sankhya ka anupat:
Effective SP per shirt = 2400 / 3 = ₹800.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹800 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: 3 shirts ka kul ankit moolya = 3 * 1200 = ₹3600.
Step 2: 1 shirt muft milne par chhoot = ₹1200.
Discount% = (1200 / 3600) * 100% = 33.33%.
Step 3: Effective price per shirt = 1200 * (1 - 1/3) = ₹800.
Atah sahi uttar '₹800' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A shopkeeper offers a 'Buy 3, Get 1 Free' scheme. What is the equivalent single discount percentage?
qh: एक दुकानदार '3 खरीदें, 1 मुफ्त पाएं' योजना की पेशकश करता है। समतुल्य एकल छूट प्रतिशत क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Sutra: Discount% = [Muft vastuyein / (Kharidi gayi + Muft vastuyein)] * 100%.
Step 2: Muft = 1, Kul = 3 + 1 = 4 units.
Discount ratio = 1 / 4.
Step 3: Discount% = (1 / 4) * 100% = 25%.
Atah sahi vikalp  25% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Mana 1 vastu ka MP = ₹100.
Kul 4 vastuo ka MP = ₹400.
Step 2: Grahak keval 3 vastuo ka bhugtan karta hai = ₹300.
Step 3: Chhoot = 400 - 300 = ₹100.
Discount% = (100 / 400) * 100% = 25%.
Atah sahi uttar '25%' hai.

Exam point: sarkari yojana ka tathya - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Murlidhar, the owner of a grocery store, offers a discount scheme 'buy 5 water bottles get 1 for free' to his customers. What is the effective percentage discount offered by Murlidhar? (correct up to two decimal places)
qh: किराना दुकान के मालिक मुरलीधर अपने ग्राहकों को '5 पानी की बोतलें खरीदें 1 मुफ्त पाएं' छूट योजना की पेशकश करते हैं। मुरलीधर द्वारा दी जाने वाली प्रभावी प्रतिशत छूट क्या है? (दो दशमलव स्थानों तक सही)
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Muft botlein = 1, Kul di gayi botlein = 5 + 1 = 6 units.
Step 2: Discount ratio = 1 / 6.
Step 3: Discount% = (1 / 6) * 100% = 16.666...% ≈ 16.67%.
Atah sahi vikalp  16.67% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Mana pratyek bottle ka MP = ₹10.
6 botlo ka MP = ₹60.
Step 2: Grahak ne chukaye (5 botlo ke) = ₹50.
Step 3: Chhoot = 60 - 50 = ₹10.
Discount% = (10 / 60) * 100% = 16.67%.
Atah sahi uttar '16.67%' hai.

Exam point: sarkari yojana ka tathya - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A store advertises, "Buy items worth ₹3000, get ₹500 off instantly." What is the effective discount percentage?
qh: एक स्टोर विज्ञापन देता है, "₹3000 का सामान खरीदें, तुरंत ₹500 की छूट पाएं।" प्रभावी छूट प्रतिशत क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: MP = ₹3000, Discount = ₹500.
Step 2: Discount aur MP ka anupat = 500 : 3000 = 1 : 6.
Step 3: Discount% = (1 / 6) * 100% = 16.666...% ≈ 16.67%.
Atah sahi vikalp  16.67% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Discount% = (Chhoot / Kul kharid moolya) * 100%.
Step 2: Discount% = (500 / 3000) * 100% = 50 / 3% ≈ 16.67%.
Atah sahi uttar '16.67%' hai.

Yahan chhoot aur ankitan moolya ka niyam seedha lagta hai. Vikalp 15.67%, 14.67%, 13.67% is hal se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: chhoot aur ankitan moolya ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein, samay bachega.

qe: During a new-year sale, a shopkeeper offers a discount scheme to his customers, 'Buy 5 Sweaters, Get 2 Sweaters Free'. Find the effective percentage discount given by the shopkeeper.
qh: नए साल की बिक्री के दौरान, एक दुकानदार अपने ग्राहकों को '5 स्वेटर खरीदें, 2 स्वेटर मुफ्त पाएं' छूट योजना की पेशकश करता है। दुकानदार द्वारा दी जाने वाली प्रभावी प्रतिशत छूट ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Muft sweatero ki sankhya = 2.
Kul sweatero ki sankhya = 5 + 2 = 7 units.
Step 2: Discount ratio = 2 / 7.
Step 3: Discount% = (2 / 7) * 100% = 200 / 7% = 28$\frac{4}{7}$%.
Atah sahi vikalp  28 4/7% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Mana 1 sweater ka MP = ₹100.
7 sweatero ka kul MP = ₹700.
Step 2: Grahak dwara bhugtan ki gayi rashi (5 sweaters) = ₹500.
Step 3: Chhoot = 700 - 500 = ₹200.
Discount% = (200 / 700) * 100% = 28$\frac{4}{7}$%.
Atah sahi uttar '28$\frac{4}{7}$%' hai.

Exam point: sarkari yojana ka tathya - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: On buying 24 bangles Meena gets 6 bangles free of cost. By what percentage does Meena get a discount?
qh: 24 चूड़ियाँ खरीदने पर मीना को 6 चूड़ियाँ मुफ्त मिलती हैं। मीना को कितने प्रतिशत की छूट मिलती है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Muft choodiyan = 6, Kul di gayi choodiyan = 24 + 6 = 30 units.
Step 2: Discount ratio = 6 / 30 = 1 / 5.
Step 3: Discount% = (1 / 5) * 100% = 20%.
Atah sahi vikalp  20% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Mana 1 choori ka MP = ₹1.
30 choodiyon ka kul MP = ₹30.
Step 2: Bhugtan kiya gaya (24 choodiyon ke liye) = ₹24.
Step 3: Chhoot = 30 - 24 = ₹6.
Discount% = (6 / 30) * 100% = 20%.
Atah sahi uttar '20%' hai.

Exam point: chhoot aur ankitan moolya ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: To clear the old stock, Arshad offers a discount scheme to his customers - on buying 24 glass tumblers get 12 glass tumblers free. What is the effective percentage discount given by Arshad to his customers?
qh: पुराने स्टॉक को खाली करने के लिए, अरशद अपने ग्राहकों को एक छूट योजना की पेशकश करता है - 24 ग्लास टम्बलर खरीदने पर 12 ग्लास टम्बलर मुफ्त मिलते हैं। अरशद द्वारा अपने ग्राहकों को दी जाने वाली प्रभावी प्रतिशत छूट क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Muft tumblers = 12, Kul tumblers = 24 + 12 = 36 units.
Step 2: Discount ratio = 12 / 36 = 1 / 3.
Step 3: Discount% = (1 / 3) * 100% = 33$\frac{1}{3}$%.
Atah sahi vikalp  33 1/3% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Mana 1 tumbler ka MP = ₹10.
36 tumblers ka MP = ₹360.
Step 2: Grahak chukata hai = 24 * 10 = ₹240.
Step 3: Chhoot = 360 - 240 = ₹120.
Discount% = (120 / 360) * 100% = 33$\frac{1}{3}$%.
Atah sahi uttar '33$\frac{1}{3}$%' hai.

Exam point: sarkari yojana ka tathya - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: What is the effective discount percentage if a shopkeeper offers a scheme discount 'buy five and get one free'?
qh: यदि कोई दुकानदार 'पांच खरीदें और एक मुफ्त पाएं' छूट योजना की पेशकश करता है तो प्रभावी छूट प्रतिशत क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Muft vastu = 1, Kul vastuyein = 5 + 1 = 6 units.
Step 2: Discount ratio = 1 / 6.
Step 3: Discount% = (1 / 6) * 100% = 16.666...% ≈ 16.67%.
Atah sahi vikalp  16.67% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Mana 1 vastu ka MP = ₹100.
6 vastuon ka MP = ₹600.
Step 2: SP (5 vastuon ka) = ₹500.
Step 3: Chhoot = ₹100 ==> Discount% = (100 / 600) * 100% ≈ 16.67%.
Atah sahi uttar '16.67%' hai.

sarkari yojana ka tathya se hi is prashn ka jawab nikalta hai. She sh vikalp 16.33%, 15.33%, 15.67% is hisaab se nahi milte. Exam point: sarkari yojana ka tathya - ise yaad rakhein, samay bachega.

qe:
A shopkeeper offers the following two discount schemes.
A. Buy 3 get 4 free
B. Buy 5 get 6 free
Which scheme has the maximum discount percentage?
qh:
एक दुकानदार निम्नलिखित दो छूट योजनाओं की पेशकश करता है।
A. 3 खरीदें 4 मुफ्त पाएं
B. 5 खरीदें 6 मुफ्त पाएं
किस योजना में अधिकतम छूट प्रतिशत है?
oe: A does not give any discount
A and B both have the same discount percentage
oh: A does not give any discount
A and B both have the same discount percentage
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Scheme A me Discount% nikalein:
Muft = 4, Kul = 3 + 4 = 7 units.
Discount% (A) = (4 / 7) * 100% = 57.14%.
Step 2: Scheme B me Discount% nikalein:
Muft = 6, Kul = 5 + 6 = 11 units.
Discount% (B) = (6 / 11) * 100% = 54.54%.
Step 3: Tulna karein: 57.14% > 54.54%.
Scheme A me chhoot adhiktam hai.
Atah sahi vikalp  A hai.

Method 2 (Fraction Cross-Multiplication Method):
Step 1: Scheme A fraction = 4/7.
Step 2: Scheme B fraction = 6/11.
Step 3: Cross multiply: 4 * 11 = 44 aur 7 * 6 = 42.
Chunki 44 > 42, isliye 4/7 > 6/11.
Atah Scheme A me adhiktam discount hai. Sahi uttar 'A' hai.

Exam point: sarkari yojana ka tathya - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A sweet shop owner buys 10 boxes of sweets for the price of 8 boxes from a wholesaler. If he sells each box at a 2% discount on its marked price, what is his profit percentage?
qh: एक मिठाई की दुकान का मालिक एक थोक व्यापारी से 8 बक्सों की कीमत पर 10 बक्से मिठाई खरीदता है। यदि वह प्रत्येक बक्से को उसके अंकित मूल्य पर 2% की छूट पर बेचता है, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Mana 1 box ka marked price (MP) = ₹100.
10 boxes ka MP = 10 * 100 = ₹1000.
Step 2: Usne 10 boxes 8 boxes ke MP par kharide ==> Dukandar ka Kul CP = 8 * 100 = ₹800.
Step 3: Usne pratyek box ko 2% chhoot par becha ==> 1 box ka SP = 100 - 2 = ₹98.
10 boxes ka Kul SP = 10 * 98 = ₹980.
Step 4: CP : SP = 800 : 980 = 40 : 49.
Labh = 49 - 40 = 9 units.
Step 5: Profit% = (9 / 40) * 100% = 90 / 4% = 22.5%.
Atah sahi vikalp  22.5% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: CP per box = (8 * 100) / 10 = ₹80.
Step 2: SP per box = 100 * 0.98 = ₹98.
Step 3: Profit per box = 98 - 80 = ₹18.
Step 4: Profit% = (18 / 80) * 100% = (9 / 40) * 100% = 22.5%.
Atah sahi uttar '22.5%' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A bookshop advertises: "Buy 4 books and get the 5th at 50% discount." If the marked price of each book is ₹480 and all books are priced the same, what is the effective percentage discount the customer receives on the total purchase?
qh: एक किताबों की दुकान विज्ञापन देती है: "4 किताबें खरीदें और 5वीं किताब 50% छूट पर पाएं।" यदि प्रत्येक किताब का अंकित मूल्य ₹480 है और सभी किताबों की कीमत समान है, तो कुल खरीद पर ग्राहक को मिलने वाली प्रभावी प्रतिशत छूट क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Step 1: Kul 5 kitabein li jaati hain. Pratyek ka MP = 1 unit (ya ₹480).
5 kitabo ka kul MP = 5 units.
Step 2: Chhoot keval 5vin kitab par 50% hai ==> Kul chhoot = 0.5 unit.
Step 3: Discount ratio = 0.5 / 5 = 1 / 10.
Step 4: Effective Discount% = (1 / 10) * 100% = 10%.
Atah sahi vikalp  10% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Step 1: Kul MP = 5 * 480 = ₹2400.
Step 2: 4 kitabo ki keemat = 4 * 480 = ₹1920.
5vin kitab ki keemat (50% chhoot) = 480 * 0.50 = ₹240.
Kul bhugtan (SP) = 1920 + 240 = ₹2160.
Step 3: Kul chhoot = 2400 - 2160 = ₹240.
Step 4: Discount% = (240 / 2400) * 100% = 10%.
Atah sahi uttar '10%' hai.

Exam point: chhoot aur ankitan moolya ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
